subject: delta(client): WF pass an effect boundary to the base's new seller transport callers and expect the host stop refusal for a stop while a request is signed
note: The merge brought in seller transport callers written before this side made the effect boundary a required option, so each threw at construction. The review decisions test, the authority test, the public composition world and the client kit, whose sessions never sign, pass the read-only test boundary, which now also refuses a signer; the session restart test, which signs, passes its flow world's own boundary once the flow starts, as it already does for the endpoint proof. The base passes a host stop refusal through the seller client when nothing was written, so a stop that arrives while a request is being signed now reaches the caller as that refusal rather than as an unsent seller call; the signature path test expects that refusal for the stop case, keeps the unsent class for a re-hold and a reconnect, and still checks that no request is written.
